notes: in: op (dragLook | canPlace | shapeFrom) + its inputs. dragLook: ghostPos, cursorPos, defaultYaw -> out.yaw (compare as angles). canPlace: ghosts [{squad, pos}], anchorSquad, squad, pos -> out.result (ok | too_far | too_close). shapeFrom: ghosts [{squad, pos, yaw}], anchorSquad -> out.shape {members [{squad, fwd, right, look}]} (RoundShape applied: 0.1 cm / 0.1 deg; look compares as an angle; empty members = no anchor ghost).
